summary.en: One card that runs a call: title, language tabs with a leading-edge highlight, code, the endpoint and a Run button; in paper or as the ink console.
summary.zh: 一张能运行调用的卡片：标题、前沿先动的语言标签、代码、接口和运行按钮；可以是纸色，也可以是墨色控制台。

fits: A call shown in several languages; the console after it runs.
notFor: More than four tabs; long programs.

intent.en: One call in one card, with the language the viewer uses one tab away.
intent.zh: 一张卡一个调用，观众用的语言就在一个标签页之外。

content.en: A title (≤ 28 / 12 字), 1–4 tabs (language, code lines), a Run label (≤ 6 / 3 字).
content.zh: 标题（≤ 28 字符 / 12 字），1–4 个标签页（语言、代码行），运行按钮文字（≤ 6 字符 / 3 字）。

fits.zh: 一个调用用几种语言展示；运行之后的控制台。

notFor.zh: 超过四个标签页；长程序。

en: In the ink material the highlight is an outline; filling it in the accent would compete with the status line.
zh: 墨色材质里高亮只描边；填强调色会和状态行抢。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
